title: Slice 4: glyph code-map and opum-cli integration
description: DEC-216 (opum-doc, 2026-10-20), Q6: a glyph code-map subcommand that emits the CodeMapProducer seam's exact {pointers, omissions} JSON, called by opum-cli through its existing runCli adapter under a time budget measured and fixed before integration. The deterministic producer stays as the fallback and the mutation control, and opum-cli takes no library dependency on Glyph. The opum-cli side needs its own task, filed by opum-agent through opum-cli. Requested by opum-agent for ODOC-487.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `glyph code-map` emits exactly the seam's `{ pointers, omissions }` shape for the seam's input (task text, source ref and repository), with pointer paths and line ranges in the form the seam consumes.
The output respects the seam's 20-file and 2,000-token caps in Glyph itself as well as the consumer re-applying them, and every omitted candidate is named in `omissions`.
A time budget is measured and fixed in a record before integration, and a run that exceeds it fails with an actionable error rather than hanging the compile.
The same repository state and source ref yield byte-identical output apart from cache status.

The opum-cli side calls Glyph through its existing `runCli` adapter, keeps the deterministic producer as fallback and mutation control, and adds no library dependency on Glyph; the opum-cli change is tracked by its own task.
Tests cover a full clean result, cap truncation, byte-identical repeat runs and the fallback when Glyph is unavailable; `bun run check` passes; README and an ADR record the seam and the budget.
